rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken rendering for something belonging to or associated with them.

example.english: I've seen their new house; it's really big.
example.traditional: 我見過佢哋嘅新屋，真係好大。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gin3 gwo3 keoi5 dei6 ge3 san1 uk1 zan1 hai6 hou2 daai6

rows.note: A speaker picks this formal written rendering in official or literary Chinese rather than everyday conversation.

example.english: The committee has approved their plan.
example.traditional: 委員會已批准他們的計劃。
example.jyutping: wai2 jyun4 wui6 ji5 pai1 zeon2 taa1 mun4 dik1 gai3 waak6
